answer: An identity earns its seat through transit card tap proof with stored-value receipt, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. Cloning 554 keys multiplies the price 554-fold: 55954 POA locked, or 9418 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. The lagoon sits in the mechanism itself, the nadir sits in the price of faking it, and the comet sits in the record no template can forge. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
